requiredFindings.title: Include the post-run checker in the pinned run package
requiredFindings.detail: The reviewed run plan invokes run_c1a4b_post_checks.py after the one blind run, but no such file is present in the committed-path package or its 107-member subject manifest. The only located runner is /tmp/opensip-implementation/run_c1a4b_post_checks.py, 2555 bytes, SHA-256 9a5d167071a4e4eb8cd34d0c47870ddb9c871a61fe95e82c9633f4bbfea5e799. Its current source uses the intended census tests, synthetic controls and verify_design, but those bytes and its location are not bound by this subject, and the bare invocation does not resolve from the stated committed architecture path. The exact end-to-end procedure whose authorization is requested is therefore incomplete, even though the two blind-mode commands themselves are reviewable.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Archive the actual post-run checker under the package, include its exact bytes/hash in the subject, and update RUN-PLAN.md to an unambiguous interpreter/path invocation. Alternatively replace that invocation with the exact reviewed post-run commands and lane/environment procedure in the pinned run plan. Resubmit the updated manifest for the pre-run gate; do not spend the one blind run before the complete procedure is accepted.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Make the stated freeze and detached-worktree preconditions executable
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The runner verifies equal main/worktree HEADs, clean status and the five tool hashes. It does not independently verify that the worktree is detached or that main is exactly b753854 plus only the gate code commit. Those stronger conditions are explicit RUN-PLAN preconditions and remain necessary: the five hashes alone do not freeze every bound Rust/identity/reference source.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Before removing the old receipt, assert detached HEAD and the exact approved code commit/base relationship and changed-path set, or record a separate exact preflight proving these conditions. Do not interpret the existing equal-HEAD/tool checks as a substitute for the broader freeze.
